name: DeathTracker
description: # DeathTrackerWatches hit points and marks tokens as **Bloodied**, **Dying**, **Stable** or **Dead**. Tracks death saves for player characters (read from the D&D 2024 sheet as boxes are ticked or saves rolled, or from checkbox fields on the 2014 sheet), and can move the dead to the GM or Map layer and take them out of the turn order.**Version 1.0.0 is a full rewrite of Robin Kuiper's 0.1.8** for Jumpgate and the D&D 2024 sheet. 0.1 settings carry over and `!dead` still works.* Any marker in the game, including custom sets and the 2024 sheet's condition markers.* Choose the hit point bar; empty bars are never read as 0.* Optional tint and hurt/heal effects; with HealthColors 2.5, choose which Mod does death saves, colours and effects.* Chat menu, Help and Command Deck handouts in 24 languages.Type `!deathtracker` for the menu. Full instructions are in the **DeathTracker - Help** handout.

useroptions.name: language
useroptions.description: Language of menus, messages and handouts.

useroptions.name: hpBar
useroptions.description: The bar that holds hit points.

useroptions.name: bloodiedPercent
useroptions.description: Bloodied at or below this percentage of maximum hit points (0 turns Bloodied off).

useroptions.name: bloodiedMarker
useroptions.description: Marker name or tag for Bloodied, or none.

useroptions.name: dyingMarker
useroptions.description: Marker for a dying PC (for example Unconscious on the D&D 2024 sheet).

useroptions.name: stableMarker
useroptions.description: Marker for a stable PC.

useroptions.name: deadMarker
useroptions.description: Marker for the dead.

useroptions.name: pcDetection
useroptions.description: auto: controlled by a player or the sheet is not an NPC sheet; players: controlled by a player only.

useroptions.name: deathSaves
useroptions.description: PCs at 0 hit points make death saves: three successes are Stable, three failures Dead.

useroptions.name: resetSheetSaves
useroptions.description: Clear the sheet's death save boxes when a PC drops to 0 and when healed, and show them on the D&D 2024 sheet.

useroptions.name: successFields
useroptions.description: Sheet fields ticked for death save successes (2014 and other sheets).

useroptions.name: failureFields
useroptions.description: Sheet fields ticked for death save failures.

useroptions.name: massiveDamage
useroptions.description: A PC whose bar goes below 0 by at least its maximum dies outright.

useroptions.name: announce
useroptions.description: Who is told when a PC goes down, becomes stable, dies or gets up.

useroptions.name: deathLayer
useroptions.description: Move dead tokens to the GM layer or the Map layer.

useroptions.name: deathTurnOrder
useroptions.description: Remove dead tokens from the turn order.

useroptions.name: deathActionsFor
useroptions.description: npc: moving and turn order apply to NPCs; all: to PCs as well.

useroptions.name: tintPlayers
useroptions.description: Tint PCs from green to red as they lose hit points.

useroptions.name: tintNpcs
useroptions.description: Tint NPCs the same way.

useroptions.name: hurtFx
useroptions.description: Play an effect when a token loses hit points.

useroptions.name: hurtFxType
useroptions.description: Built-in effect as type-colour.

useroptions.name: healFx
useroptions.description: Play an effect when a token gains hit points.

useroptions.name: healFxType
useroptions.description: Built-in effect as type-colour.
